import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from your_module import MachineLearningAlgorithm, PaymentGateway

class TestMachineLearningAlgorithm(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_train_model(self):
        # Arrange
        training_data = ["data1", "data2", "data3"]  # Use SRS values or remove
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        ml_algorithm.train_model(training_data)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(ml_algorithm.model_trained)

    def test_combine_training_and_live_data(self):
        # Arrange
        training_data = ["data1", "data2", "data3"]  # Use SRS values or remove
        live_data = ["data4", "data5", "data6"]  # Use SRS values or remove
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        ml_algorithm.combine_data(training_data, live_data)

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(ml_algorithm.model_updated)

    def test_prediction_accuracy(self):
        # Arrange
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        prediction = ml_algorithm.predict()

        # Assert
        self.assertAlmostEqual(prediction, 0.55, places=2)  # Test boundary condition

    def test_seasonal_disease_prediction(self):
        # Arrange
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        seasonal_prediction = ml_algorithm.seasonal_disease_prediction()

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(seasonal_prediction)

    def test_patient_segmentation(self):
        # Arrange
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        patient_segmentation = ml_algorithm.patient_segmentation()

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(patient_segmentation)

    def test_payment_gateway_interface(self):
        # Arrange
        payment_gateway = PaymentGateway()
        payment_gateway_response = Mock()
        payment_gateway_response.status_code = 200

        # Act
        payment_gateway_response = payment_gateway.make_payment("patient", "amount")

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(payment_gateway_response.status_code, 200)

    def test_cash_payment(self):
        # Arrange
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        cash_payment = ml_algorithm.cash_payment()

        # Assert
        self.assertTrue(cash_payment)

    def test_no_doctor_roster(self):
        # Arrange
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        doctor_roster = ml_algorithm.get_doctor_roster()

        # Assert
        self.assertIsNone(doctor_roster)

    def test_no_appointment_slot_validation(self):
        # Arrange
        ml_algorithm = MachineLearningAlgorithm()

        # Act
        appointment_slot = ml_algorithm.validate_appointment_slot()

        # Assert
        self.assertIsNone(appointment_slot)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
